simple.meaning: a relative by marriage (especially through the bride); figuratively, a circumcised child (as a species of religious espousal)
simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to חָתָן (H2860) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 20 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: חָתָן (châthân) means a relative by marriage (especially through the bride); figuratively, a circumcised child (as a species of religious espousal) First listed occurrence: 1Sam 18 18.

definitions.short: a relative by marriage (especially through the bride); figuratively, a circumcised child (as a species of religious espousal)
definitions.full: H2860. chathan חָתָן noun masculine daughter's husband, bride-groom (as one who undergoes circumcision, see above; Late Hebrew id. ; Aramaic חַתְנָא , and (also sister's husband, etc.); vulgar Arabic daughter's husband , then more Generally wife's and husband's relations; Sabean (Lihyân) חֿתן daughter's husband DHM Epigr. Denkm. 87 ; Assyrian —atanu, daughter's husband COT Gloss ) — absolute ׳ח 1Sam 18:18 10 t. + Gen 19:12 (where read ᵐ5 חֲתָנֶיךָ Ol Di); construct חֲתַן Exod 4:23 4 t.; suffix חֲתָנוֺ Judg 19:5 ; חֲתָנָיו Gen 19:14 (twice in verse); — 1 in relation to a father , daughter's husband, or bridegroom Gen 19:12 , 14 ( ׳ח בְּנֹתָיו לֹקְחֵי ), 19:14 (all J), Judg 15:6 ; 19:5 ; 1Sam 18:18 ; 22:14 ; Neh 6:18 ; 13:28 ; see also אַחְאָב בֵּית חֲתַן 2Kin 8:27 son-in-law of the house of Ahad , said of Ahaziah, whose mother Athaliah was the daughter of Ahab. 2 in relation to the bride , bridegroom ׳ח לִי אַתָּה דָּמִים Exod 4:25 a bloody bridegroom art thou to me , compare 4:26 (J; on this see We Prol. 1886, 355 ); || כַּלָּה Jer 7:34 ; 16:9 ; 25:10 ; 33:11 ; Joel 2:16 ; in simile of ׳י 's work for and delight in his people Isa 61:10 ; 62:5 ; of sun Psa 19:6 .
